name: Kwararafa against Katsina, Zazzau and Bornu

summary.text: At the same time as its attacks on Kano, Kwararafa struck the other great states of the north. Katsina was invaded between 1670 and 1684 and Zazzau attacked around 1680. With a Tuareg army from the north it besieged Ngazargamu, the Bornu capital. Mai Ali ibn Umar turned the two besiegers against each other and then beat both; Bornu tradition says he sent three captives back with their severed ears hung round their necks.

routes.label: Into Katsina (1670–1684)
routes.note: Start and target only; the road is not recorded.

moments.title: Katsina invaded
moments.text: Katsina documents record a Kwararafa invasion in these years.

moments.title: Ngazargamu besieged and saved
moments.text: Kwararafa and the Tuareg besiege the Bornu capital. Mai Ali sets them against each other, then defeats the survivors of both.

note: Wikipedia's Kwararafa article says Ngazargamu was sacked; its Jukun and Ali III articles say the attack failed. The Bornu account, that the siege was broken, is followed here.
reviewNotes: The Versus record in forces/kwararafa.json still says Kwararafa sacked Ngazargamu in 1680; it is changed to match this event.
